89: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
90: {
91:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
92:   struct pwc_message message;
93:   unsigned int next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
94:   if (next == g_tail || bytes == NULL)
95:     {
96:       return;
97:     }
98:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
99:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
100:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
101:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
102:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
103:   g_head = next;
104:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
105: }

107: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
108: {
109:   (void)argc;
110:   (void)argv;
111:   g_worker_ready = true;
112:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
113:   for (;;)
114:     {
115:       struct pwc_message message;
116:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
117:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
118:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
119:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
120:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
121:         {
122:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
123:             /* param1 retains the vendor ON/OFF response. Extended CP
124:              * firmware returns the real vote result and detected capacity
125:              * in param2 and param3.
126:              */
127: 
128:             g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
129:             g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
130:             g_psram_capacity = message.param3;
131:             if (g_psram_power_waiting)
132:               {
133:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
134:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
135:               }
136:             break;
137: 
138: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
139:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
140:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
141:               {
142:                 (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
143:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
144:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
145:                   bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
146:               }
147:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
148:               {
149:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
150: 
151:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
152:               }
153:             break;
154: 
155:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
156:             bk7258_psram_dump();
157:             break;
158: 
159:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
160:             {

164:                 PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
